evidence: Homepage shows 6 template cards each with title, author (e.g. Sarah Chen), and description.
Clicking Use Template on Professional Resume opened a dialog with template details (category, scenario, author, uses) and a Fill Template tab with the form fields.
Each card displays title, author, description, category badge, scenario badge, usage count (e.g. 1,250 uses), and update date (e.g. Updated 2024-12-01).
With all fields empty, dialog shows "Required fields missing" banner listing all field names and Preview Result tab is disabled.
All 14 fields (Full Name, Job Title, Email, Phone, Summary, Company, Position, Start/End Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills) accepted typed values.
After filling required fields, Preview Result tab enabled and displayed generated resume with entered values substituted (name, title, company, etc.).

Preview rendered proper Markdown: H1 name heading, H2 section headings (Professional Summary, Experience, Education, Skills), H3 subheading, separator line, bold/emphasis text, and all placeholders replaced with entered values (no unresolved {{}} tokens).
Clicking Copy to Clipboard showed toast "Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied."

actual: Entered 'not-an-email' (invalid email format) into the required Email field; the Preview Result tab became enabled and generated a preview embedding 'not-an-email' verbatim, with no validation error or rejection.

issue: Preview becomes available despite an invalid field value
actual: With the required Email field containing an invalid value ('not-an-email'), all other fields nonblank, the Preview Result tab was enabled and produced a preview, instead of remaining unavailable until the value is valid.

Field-level validation blocks only < > { } [ ] \\ | ` characters, but Markdown syntax characters like # and ** are allowed. Entering '# Injected Heading **Bold**' into Full Name field was accepted and the generated preview rendered '**Bold**' as actual bold text (strong element), altering the intended formatting/structure of the generated document instead of being neutralized or escaped.

evidence: Category filter (Resume) reduced results to 1 of 6; Scenario filter (Academic) reduced to 1 of 6; Sort by Alphabetical reordered cards correctly (Academic Research Summary, Meeting Minutes, Professional Email, Professional Resume, Project Proposal, Weekly Status Report); Most Popular, Recently Updated, Oldest First, Alphabetical options all present.
Changing Category/Scenario filters and Sort By instantly updated 'Showing X of 6 templates' count and card order without any page reload/navigation.
Typing 'resu' (4 chars, exact substring) showed a suggestion dropdown with 'Professional Resume'; clicking it filled the search box with the full title and narrowed results to 1 of 6.

actual: Searching 'Resme' and 'Reusme' (small typos of 'Resume') both returned 'No templates found' / 'Showing 0 of 6 templates' with no suggestions, instead of matching or suggesting the 'Professional Resume' template. Search only matches exact substrings.

evidence: Clicking heart icon on Professional Resume added it to favorites (header badge showed 'Favorites 1'); clicking Favorites button opened favorites-only view showing just that template; unfavoriting removed it and view showed 'No favorites yet'.

Within favorites-only view, searching 'Resume' still showed the favorited Professional Resume (1 result); searching 'Meeting' (a non-favorited template) returned 'No favorites yet' (0 results), confirming search operates within the favorites scope.

Favoriting Professional Resume immediately updated the header Favorites badge from 'Favorites' to 'Favorites 1' and toggled the heart icon to active state; unfavoriting reverted the badge and list instantly.
Clicking Submit Template with all fields empty showed toast 'Missing required fields - Please fill in all required fields.' and the dialog remained open without submitting.

Submit Template dialog accepted a Markdown template with title, author, description, category, scenario, content using {{fieldName}} syntax, and one defined field (Name); submission succeeded with 'Template submitted!' toast.
After submission, 'QA Test Template' immediately appeared in the library grid (Showing 7 of 7 templates), was selectable via Use Template, and opened its fill form and generated a preview.
Immediately after submitting, the library count updated from 'Showing 6 of 6' to 'Showing 7 of 7 templates' and the new card rendered, with no page reload/navigation performed.

issue: Unmapped content placeholders are not validated at submission
actual: Submitted a template whose content contained two placeholders {{name}} and {{date}} but only declared one field (Name, mapping to {{name}}). Submission succeeded without any error about the unmapped {{date}} placeholder. The generated preview then displayed the literal unresolved text '{{date}}' instead of blocking submission or resolving it.

issue: Duplicate field labels are accepted without rejection or disambiguation
actual: Added two fields both labeled 'Name' (both bound to the same {{name}} placeholder) via the Submit Template dialog's 'Add Field'; no warning or dedup occurred, and the template was submitted successfully as 'Duplicate Field Test' with both duplicate fields intact.

evidence: Plain Text Test template with content "Dear {{name}}, this is a *plain* text # not markdown." (Markdown OFF) rendered literal preserved text "Dear Alice, this is a *plain* text # not markdown." with asterisks/hash NOT interpreted. Weekly Status Report (Markdown-enabled) rendered proper h1/h2 headings, strong bold labels, hr separator, and list items after field substitution.

After full page reload (navigate to http://localhost:6089/), Favorites badge still shows "1" (Professional Resume favorite persisted), and all 3 custom-submitted templates (QA Test Template, Duplicate Field Test, Plain Text Test) remain present, bringing total to 9 of 9 templates shown.
